source.name: Pressure
source.originalDescription: Damaging a Pokémon from the opposing team below 10% max HP and frozen by Suicune deals an additional 15% max HP as true damage to the target (sufficient damage reduction can prevent the target from being knocked out). Using a move grants a shield for 5s (up to 2 times); separately increases the crystal gauge by 1 for 5s (becoming full when increased 2 times). Flooded areas created by Whirlpool or Surf remain for 5s; opposing Pokémon in a flooded area are marked as drenched for 3s. Freezing a flooded area with a regular move (not Unite Move) also freezes opposing Pokémon in that flooded area for 1s. Freezing an opposing Pokémon marked as drenched removes the mark; targets frozen by a regular move or by a frozen area cannot be marked as drenched for 3s afterward. Deals bonus damage when freezing opposing Pokémon with a regular move or by being in a frozen area.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Pressure は こおり・凍結を付与する、受けるダメージを軽減する、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。

source.name: Avalanche
source.originalDescription: Creates snow to fall at the designated area for 1.5s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect (up to 3 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s when hit. After 1.5s, drops a clump of snow at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon again. The clump of snow freezes drenched targets for 1s when it hits; freezes flooded areas it drops on after 1s.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Avalanche は こおり・凍結を付与する、移動速度を下げる、遅延または時間差でダメージを与える。

source.name: Endless Ice Spikes
source.originalDescription: Cleanses the user of status condition; then creates ice spikes in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and freezing those hit for 2s. After 2s, the ice spikes explode, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect again. This Unite Move does not directly interact with drench marks, nor does it freeze flooded areas. Suicune can be stunned after cleansing themself and before creating the ice spikes, canceling the Unite Move and refunding 90% of the Unite Move gauge. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Endless Ice Spikes は こおり・凍結を付与する、行動不能・スタンを付与する、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、遅延または時間差でダメージを与える、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。
